Sentence (English): I wanted to upgrade all of my outdated white kitchen appliances to a modern stainless steel look.
Comments (English): [ Stressful research became the best purchase ] || ---------------- || I wanted to upgrade all of my outdated white kitchen appliances to a modern stainless steel look. The dishwasher was the first to tackle and I was met by conflicting reviews of ALL dishwasher brands and models on the Internet. I dug deep and ruled out the brands that had more consistent issues and poor reviews. Next was checking off the features I wanted: stainless steel, quiet running noise, water/dryer efficiency, and ease of customer support (should it be needed). After more research I narrowed it down to the Bosch 500 and 800. They both checked off everything I was looking for. The main difference was the drying style as the 800 uses CrystalDry for effective heat drying while the 500 has an auto open feature; allowing the dishes to completely air dry at the end of the cycle. I preferred the auto open feature and thus decided on the 500. The Bluetooth feature surprised me as I didn't *need* it for my washer per say. After fiddling around on the app however I do enjoy the customization the Bluetooth allows you to set your wash cycles exactly as you want. My spouse is less tech savvy so preprograming the washer allows for ease of use for the both of us. I've used this washer for multiple months now and it is day and night compared to my old dishwasher. If your checklist is similar to mine I do recommend the Bosch 500

Sentence (English): "Benchmark" is the 3rd Bosch dishwasher that I've owned over the last 20+ years.
Comments (English): [ Truly a Benchmark ] || ---------------- || "Benchmark" is the 3rd Bosch dishwasher that I've owned over the last 20+ years. I only experienced minor issues with previous machines that included replacing a door pulley rope and defective door switch. In my opinion, this "Benchmark" machine sets the performance bar pretty high for other manufacturers to compete with. When the machine is run with "Finish Quantum Powerball Pods", the results are nothing short of amazing. Removing tea stains in cups and tea infusers were always challenging and required mechanical cleaning with "Bar Keepers Friend" to get the job done. No mechanical cleaning is required with the "Benchmark" machine, as the tea stained items come out like new after just one cycle. The drying of plastic items is outstanding, "CrystalDry" really works well. The adjust-ability of the dishwasher racks make the job of loading painless. The interior light is not essential, but is still a nice touch. The included salt dispenser is great for eliminating performance issues related to water hardness. Highly recommend!

Sentence (English): "Benchmark" is the 3rd Bosch dishwasher that I've owned over the last 20+ years.
Comments (English): [ Truly a Benchmark ] || ---------------- || "Benchmark" is the 3rd Bosch dishwasher that I've owned over the last 20+ years. I only experienced minor issues with previous machines that included replacing a door pulley rope and defective door switch. In my opinion, this "Benchmark" machine sets the performance bar pretty high for other manufacturers to compete with. When the machine is run with "Finish Quantum Powerball Pods", the results are nothing short of amazing. Removing tea stains in cups and tea infusers were always challenging and required mechanical cleaning with "Bar Keepers Friend" to get the job done. No mechanical cleaning is required with the "Benchmark" machine, as the tea stained items come out like new after just one cycle. The drying of plastic items is outstanding, "CrystalDry" really works well. The adjustability of the dishwasher racks make the job of loading painless. The interior light is not essential, but is still a nice touch. The included salt dispenser is great for eliminating performance issues related to water hardness. Highly recommend!

Sentence (English): I have used the dishwasher only a few times.
Comments (English): [ Sleek and Black ] || ---------------- || I have used the dishwasher only a few times. It replaced an older version that needed a new pump. I chose the old one because it loaded my cereal bowls, plates, and pasta bowls so well. The new one looks, from the outside, just like the first. However, there are differences which I do not like as well. The tines holding plates and bowls on lower shelf are not dog legged. Or they do not notch in at bottom to accept outside curve of plate or pasta bowl. Therefore, they do not stand straight up but like to lean on the one next to them. This causes rinsing not to be as effective and sometimes depositing and leaving food on the plate or bowl. It seems LG took a step backward. Also it seems to leave dishes wetter than the older model. I have found it works better when I do not use "energy saver" and do dishes early enough to open the door after the "end" comes on after the cycle. Almost everything is dry by morning when I unload it. I used the "auto" setting once, but my dishes were not clean. I went back to "normal". I don't really use the top shallow shelf right now. Maybe in the future. I am a person who does not put pans, large anything, large knives, wooden handles or utensils in the dishwasher. So, I do not know how they do. This is a black dishwasher which was my deciding factor.

Or they do not notch in at bottom to accept outside curve of plate or pasta bowl.  Therefore, they do not stand straight up but like to lean on the one next to them.  This causes rinsing not to be as effective and sometimes depositing and leaving food on the plate or bowl.  It seems LG took a step backward.  Also it seems to leave dishes wetter than the older model.  I have found it works better when I do not use 'energy saver' and do dishes early enough to open the door after the 'end' comes on after the cycle.  Almost everything is dry by morning when I unload it. I used the 'auto' setting once, but my dishes were not clean.  I went back to 'normal'.  I don't really use the top shallow shelf right now.  Maybe in the future.  I am a person who does not put pans, large anything, large knives, wooden handles or utensils in the dishwasher.  So, I do not know how they do.  This is a black dishwasher which was my deciding factor.

Sentence (English): Overall, I am incredibly pleased with my new Bosch 300 Series dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Excellent dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Overall, I am incredibly pleased with my new Bosch 300 Series dishwasher. It is so quiet that I wasn't sure I had even turned it on the first time I used it. It does an excellent job of cleaning the dishes. Per the manufacturer's instructions, I just scrape the plates off before loading, I don't rinse them, and they come out spotless. I love the sleek look of the machine as well. My only complaints are that the utensil basket is about 1/2 as big as it should be and none of the racks fit my wine glasses. There are several adjustable components to the racks but there's still not enough clearance to fit the tall stems on the middle rack and not a very good fit among the prongs on the bottom rack. I'd still highly recommend this machine, though.

Sentence (English): I rated this dishwasher 2 stars due to frustration, lack of confidence in the product and failure of parts.
Comments (English): [ Lower Rack Failed ] || ---------------- || I rated this dishwasher 2 stars due to frustration, lack of confidence in the product and failure of parts. Unfortunately, the lower rack started dropping, slipping off of the tracks, while being pulled open, and loaded with plates, etc. It took 2 people to lift the loaded rack up and out to unload after it jumped the tracks. I researched the Bosch website and decided to purchase all new Bosch wheels, thinking, maybe they were too small, or, the wrong ones were included for my DW. Replacing all wheels with new ones did not solve the problem. Eventually, I took off the rack and turned it upside down, and closely inspected the underside. I discovered that the weld points at each wheel location had failed, and cracked the overcoating. You can see them in the picture, including the rust from the metal underneath. All points failed where the wheels attached. These failures caused the rack to bend, sag in the middle, which ended up allowing the wheels to come off of the side tracks. I decided to replace the Bosch lower rack/basket, $100 + because this dishwasher is less than 3 years old. So far, the lower rack is holding up, but, I will remove the lower rack every month to check if the failure begins to happen again. I tried to attach a couple more pictures, but the review process limits pictures to just one.

Sentence (English): I have used the dishwasher only a few times.
Comments (English): [ Sleek and Black ] || ---------------- || I have used the dishwasher only a few times. It replaced an older version that needed a new pump. I chose the old one because it loaded my cereal bowls, plates, and pasta bowls so well. The new one looks, from the outside, just like the first. However, there are differences which I do not like as well. The tines holding plates and bowls on lower shelf are not dog legged. Or they do not notch in at bottom to accept outside curve of plate or pasta bowl. Therefore, they do not stand straight up but like to lean on the one next to them. This causes rinsing not to be as effective and sometimes depositing and leaving food on the plate or bowl. It seems LG took a step backward. Also it seems to leave dishes wetter than the older model. I have found it works better when I do not use “energy saver” and do dishes early enough to open the door after the “end” comes on after the cycle. Almost everything is dry by morning when I unload it. I used the “auto” setting once, but my dishes were not clean. I went back to “normal”. I don't really use the top shallow shelf right now. Maybe in the future. I am a person who does not put pans, large anything, large knives, wooden handles or utensils in the dishwasher. So, I do not know how they do. This is a black dishwasher which was my deciding factor.

Sentence (English): We had to quickly purchase a new dishwasher due to the water pump on our previous dishwasher going out because we had some broken glass get in (teenagers).
Comments (English): [ DO NOT BUY ] || ---------------- || We had to quickly purchase a new dishwasher due to the water pump on our previous dishwasher going out because we had some broken glass get in (teenagers). We needed something that we could get quickly and we really didn't want to spend a ton at the time. Unfortunately, we decided on this one. DO NOT REPEAT MY MISTAKE.This dishwasher has been nothing but problematic based on how we use it. The bottom rack only has four rows of tines, making organizing it next to impossible - we fit so much less because we just can't - it all falls over. The silverware basket only has two lids - so while it has four compartments, you can only use two or all four for silverware - so if you usually put larger cooking utensils in the silverware basket without a lid, you're cutting silverware cleaning space in half (and we usually run out if we do that). The top rack also is very difficult to load so that anything sits upright - though the larger spacing for cups is nice. The bottom rack is constantly being pulled off track - a problem we rarely had and was very quickly fixable with our previous dishwasher. Getting the rack back on track is also a complete pain. Additionally, we've had this dishwasher for maybe 6-9 months and we are starting to get a "bE" error code on nearly every wash. The user guide says this is a "bubble error" from either using hand dishwashing soap (we are not) or the dishwasher not being level (it is). You can find a TON of complaints about this error online. Ultimately, it would seem that the impeller motor has an issue or there is an issue with a sensor. Warranty of course only covers parts, not labor so we would either need to pay someone to fix a basically NEW dishwasher or my husband would have to spend his time and energy doing it. I'm already looking for a new dishwasher because I absolutely HATE this one so much.

Our main floor is completely open so we were looking for a model that we could run while still entertaining company. The Bluetooth connectivity is a nice option but I don't need to operate the dishwasher remotely. Overall, it's an amazing product, but I wish their installation staff were more professional.

Sentence (English): This home was built in 2020 and came with GE Profile appliances.
Comments (English): This home was built in 2020 and came with GE Profile appliances. After heavy use of the dishwasher, GE had a couple of issues that were fixed under warranty. However, their patented bottle washer and turbo wash/rinse features are what kept us replacing it with the same brand and latest model. Would I buy again? The answer is YES! The sad part of the experience was the installation. Under contract with Home Depot, the installation crew was very deceptive. During the final inspection, the crew pulled out the drawer and noted that it was missing a wheel. Knowing it was missing, the installer held it and, after inspecting it, put the bottom drawer back into the dishwasher. It wasn't until that evening when a family member noticed that the bottle washer holder and the right side wheel of the bottom tray were missing.Having already filled out the star rating without knowing about the issue, I immediately called Home Depot the next day (after 5:00 PM) to complain about the installation. GE was notified and was very accommodating in sending the missing parts. However, later on, the left side wheel of the bottom tray was not installed properly (it should slide and snap in place) and ended up on the heating element, causing it to melt. Not happy with the experience, I had to replace the left wheel from a third-party source due to the negligence of the incompetent installation crew.In the end, Home Depot lost out on more appliance purchases due to the negligence of the installation crew.

Not happy with the experience, I had to replace the left wheel from a third-party source due to the negligence of the incompetent installation crew.In the end, Home Depot lost out on more appliance purchases due to the negligence of the installation crew.

Sentence (English): This is an honest and subjective review of my purchase for 2 months.
Comments (English): [ This is something that will pay off even if you use it well for just one year. ] || ---------------- || This is an honest and subjective review of my purchase for 2 months. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Dishwasher Countertop 6-person Automatic door opening: Automatic door opening Release year: 2021 KC certification information: ZU0****-****2, RR-SEC-DW30A3030CE Reason for purchase I put one at my parents' house and bought another one of the same type for my house. It's been about two months since I bought it, so I'd like to leave another review after using it. Have you experienced any inconveniences while using it? I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. However, since it's a two-person household, when there aren't many dishes after breakfast or a simple meal, I put them in the sink and run them, which is a bit annoying. I heard that dishes with a concave back tend to collect water? The more concave the back is, the more water collects. But rather than turning the rice bowl over 180 degrees, if you use the plate holder well and tilt it at a 45 degree angle, there will be less water pooling. Detergent recommendation? I haven't tried other detergents yet, but I don't recommend the Tam* 6-person dishwasher detergent. It leaves a lot of water marks. This is really a detergent issue. Cleaning power? You have to play Tetris well for this. Since water spurts out like a fountain from the bottom, you have to make space for the water to rise. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? According to the product specifications, it says 8.7L of water consumption per cycle. I don't know what mode this refers to, but it may not be less than you think. However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". Especially for those who don’t have enough space in the kitchen or can’t install a built-in dishwasher, those who find the price of the dishwasher burdensome, and those who are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a 2-3 person household, I want to tell you to just buy it. It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Dishwasher Countertop 6-person Automatic door opening: Automatic door opening Release year: 2021 KC certification information: ZU0****-****2, RR-SEC-DW30A3030CE Reason for purchase I put one at my parents' house and bought another one of the same type for my house. I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. You have to play Tetris well for this. Since water spurts out like a fountain from the bottom, you have to make space for the water to rise. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". Especially for those who don’t have enough space in the kitchen or can’t install a built-in dishwasher, those who find the price of the dishwasher burdensome, and those who are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a 2-3 person household, I want to tell you to just buy it. It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Dishwasher Countertop 6-person Automatic door opening: Automatic door opening Release year: 2021 KC certification information: ZU0****-****2, RR-SEC-DW30A3030CE Reason for purchase I put one at my parents' house and bought another one of the same type for my house. It's been about two months since I bought it, so I'd like to leave another review after using it. Have you experienced any inconveniences while using it? I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. However, since it's a two-person household, when there aren't many dishes after breakfast or a simple meal, I put them in the sink and run them, which is a bit annoying. I haven't tried other detergents yet, but I don't recommend the Tam* 6-person dishwasher detergent. It leaves a lot of water marks. This is really a detergent issue. Cleaning power? You have to play Tetris well for this. Since water spurts out like a fountain from the bottom, you have to make space for the water to rise. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? According to the product specifications, it says 8.7L of water consumption per cycle. I don't know what mode this refers to, but it may not be less than you think. However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". Especially for those who don’t have enough space in the kitchen or can’t install a built-in dishwasher, those who find the price of the dishwasher burdensome, and those who are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a 2-3 person household, I want to tell you to just buy it. It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? According to the product specifications, it says 8.7L of water consumption per cycle. I don't know what mode this refers to, but it may not be less than you think. However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

It's been about two months since I bought it, so I'd like to leave another review after using it. Have you experienced any inconveniences while using it? I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. However, since it's a two-person household, when there aren't many dishes after breakfast or a simple meal, I put them in the sink and run them, which is a bit annoying. I haven't tried other detergents yet, but I don't recommend the Tam* 6-person dishwasher detergent. It leaves a lot of water marks. This is really a detergent issue. Cleaning power? You have to play Tetris well for this. Since water spurts out like a fountain from the bottom, you have to make space for the water to rise. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? According to the product specifications, it says 8.7L of water consumption per cycle. I don't know what mode this refers to, but it may not be less than you think. However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Dishwasher Countertop 6-person Automatic door opening: Automatic door opening Release year: 2021 KC certification information: ZU0****-****2, RR-SEC-DW30A3030CE Reason for purchase I put one at my parents' house and bought another one of the same type for my house. It's been about two months since I bought it, so I'd like to leave another review after using it. Have you experienced any inconveniences while using it? I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. However, since it's a two-person household, when there aren't many dishes after breakfast or a simple meal, I put them in the sink and run them, which is a bit annoying. I heard that dishes with a concave back tend to collect water? The more concave the back is, the more water collects. But rather than turning the rice bowl over 180 degrees, if you use the plate holder well and tilt it at a 45 degree angle, there will be less water pooling. Detergent recommendation? I haven't tried other detergents yet, but I don't recommend the Tam* 6-person dishwasher detergent. It leaves a lot of water marks. This is really a detergent issue. Cleaning power? You have to play Tetris well for this. Since water spurts out like a fountain from the bottom, you have to make space for the water to rise. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? According to the product specifications, it says 8.7L of water consumption per cycle. I don't know what mode this refers to, but it may not be less than you think. However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". Especially for those who don’t have enough space in the kitchen or can’t install a built-in dishwasher, those who find the price of the dishwasher burdensome, and those who are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a 2-3 person household, I want to tell you to just buy it. It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Dishwasher Countertop 6-person Automatic door opening: Automatic door opening Release year: 2021 KC certification information: ZU0****-****2, RR-SEC-DW30A3030CE Reason for purchase I put one at my parents' house and bought another one of the same type for my house. It's been about two months since I bought it, so I'd like to leave another review after using it. Have you experienced any inconveniences while using it? I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. However, since it's a two-person household, when there aren't many dishes after breakfast or a simple meal, I put them in the sink and run them, which is a bit annoying. I heard that dishes with a concave back tend to collect water? The more concave the back is, the more water collects. But rather than turning the rice bowl over 180 degrees, if you use the plate holder well and tilt it at a 45 degree angle, there will be less water pooling. Detergent recommendation? I haven't tried other detergents yet, but I don't recommend the Tam* 6-person dishwasher detergent. It leaves a lot of water marks. This is really a detergent issue. Cleaning power? You have to play Tetris well for this. Since water spurts out like a fountain from the bottom, you have to make space for the water to rise. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? According to the product specifications, it says 8.7L of water consumption per cycle. I don't know what mode this refers to, but it may not be less than you think. However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". Especially for those who don’t have enough space in the kitchen or can’t install a built-in dishwasher, those who find the price of the dishwasher burdensome, and those who are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a 2-3 person household, I want to tell you to just buy it. It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Dishwasher Countertop 6-person Automatic door opening: Automatic door opening Release year: 2021 KC certification information: ZU0****-****2, RR-SEC-DW30A3030CE Reason for purchase I put one at my parents' house and bought another one of the same type for my house. It's been about two months since I bought it, so I'd like to leave another review after using it. Have you experienced any inconveniences while using it? I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. However, since it's a two-person household, when there aren't many dishes after breakfast or a simple meal, I put them in the sink and run them, which is a bit annoying. I haven't tried other detergents yet, but I don't recommend the Tam* 6-person dishwasher detergent. It leaves a lot of water marks. This is really a detergent issue. Cleaning power? You have to play Tetris well for this. Since water spurts out like a fountain from the bottom, you have to make space for the water to rise. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? According to the product specifications, it says 8.7L of water consumption per cycle. I don't know what mode this refers to, but it may not be less than you think. However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Dishwasher Countertop 6-person Automatic door opening: Automatic door opening Release year: 2021 KC certification information: ZU0****-****2, RR-SEC-DW30A3030CE Reason for purchase I put one at my parents' house and bought another one of the same type for my house. It's been about two months since I bought it, so I'd like to leave another review after using it. Have you experienced any inconveniences while using it? I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. However, since it's a two-person household, when there aren't many dishes after breakfast or a simple meal, I put them in the sink and run them, which is a bit annoying. I heard that dishes with a concave back tend to collect water? The more concave the back is, the more water collects. But rather than turning the rice bowl over 180 degrees, if you use the plate holder well and tilt it at a 45 degree angle, there will be less water pooling. Detergent recommendation? I haven't tried other detergents yet, but I don't recommend the Tam* 6-person dishwasher detergent. It leaves a lot of water marks. This is really a detergent issue. Cleaning power? You have to play Tetris well for this. Since water spurts out like a fountain from the bottom, you have to make space for the water to rise. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? According to the product specifications, it says 8.7L of water consumption per cycle. I don't know what mode this refers to, but it may not be less than you think. However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". Especially for those who don’t have enough space in the kitchen or can’t install a built-in dishwasher, those who find the price of the dishwasher burdensome, and those who are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a 2-3 person household, I want to tell you to just buy it. It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Dishwasher Countertop 6-person Automatic door opening: Automatic door opening Release year: 2021 KC certification information: ZU0****-****2, RR-SEC-DW30A3030CE Reason for purchase I put one at my parents' house and bought another one of the same type for my house. It's been about two months since I bought it, so I'd like to leave another review after using it. Have you experienced any inconveniences while using it? I don't know of any particular inconveniences and I'm using it. However, since it's a two-person household, when there aren't many dishes after breakfast or a simple meal, I put them in the sink and run them, which is a bit annoying. I heard that dishes with a concave back tend to collect water? The more concave the back is, the more water collects. But rather than turning the rice bowl over 180 degrees, if you use the plate holder well and tilt it at a 45 degree angle, there will be less water pooling. Detergent recommendation? I haven't tried other detergents yet, but I don't recommend the Tam* 6-person dishwasher detergent. It leaves a lot of water marks. This is really a detergent issue. Cleaning power? You have to play Tetris well for this. Since water spurts out like a fountain from the bottom, you have to make space for the water to rise. If you stack large plates or frying pans right on top of each other, they won't be cleaned at all. Cleaning space for frying pans, pots, etc.? First, stack plates and bowls well, and then turn over a frying pan or pot at the very end. Water will flow between the plates, so it will be cleaned well. (Refer to the photo) Instead, you just need to make sure that there is space for the rotating blades on the ceiling to turn. What mode do you use the most? I usually use the standard/rapid mode and apply high-temperature sterilization + strong drying. If you play Tetris well and stack the dishes well, you can clean them well enough. Is pre-washing necessary? Rice stuck to the bowl, mozzarella cheese that melted and hardened, dried ssamjang stuck to the bowl, etc., even on normal mode, there will be some residue. Just rinse them roughly in the sink, scrub them with a sponge, and run the dishwasher. How are food scraps discharged? There is a net-like thing at the bottom of the dishwasher blades that collects food in the sink. If they accumulate there, you can clean them once. Water consumption? According to the product specifications, it says 8.7L of water consumption per cycle. I don't know what mode this refers to, but it may not be less than you think. However, if you usually keep the water running and wash a lot of dishes, you will use that much. In cases like ours where the sink is small, there are some houses where it is inconvenient to pour water and use it, so there are cases where you have to keep letting it drain, so I think the standards for this will vary from house to house. What to watch out for? The thin and wide silicone gets a little distorted after high-temperature sterilization/strong drying. Conclusion: I don’t think any dishwasher can satisfy everyone 100% no matter what kind of dishwasher you buy. This product is a product that I recommend you buy \"despite all that\". Especially for those who don’t have enough space in the kitchen or can’t install a built-in dishwasher, those who find the price of the dishwasher burdensome, and those who are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a 2-3 person household, I want to tell you to just buy it. It is less burdensome than dishwashers that cost more than a hundred million won, and it is worth the price. I think I got my money’s worth even if I used this dishwasher well for a year. Then have a good day today! I hope my review was helpful!

Sentence (English): This home was built in 2020 and came with GE Profile appliances.
Comments (English): This home was built in 2020 and came with GE Profile appliances. After heavy use of the dishwasher, GE had a couple of issues that were fixed under warranty. However, their patented bottle washer and turbo wash/rinse features are what kept us replacing it with the same brand and latest model. Would I buy again? The answer is YES! The sad part of the experience was the installation. Under contract with Home Depot, the installation crew was very deceptive. During the final inspection, the crew pulled out the drawer and noted that it was missing a wheel. Knowing it was missing, the installer held it and, after inspecting it, put the bottom drawer back into the dishwasher. It wasn't until that evening when a family member noticed that the bottle washer holder and the right side wheel of the bottom tray were missing. Having already filled out the star rating without knowing about the issue, I immediately called Home Depot the next day (after 5:00 PM) to complain about the installation. GE was notified and was very accommodating in sending the missing parts. However, later on, the left side wheel of the bottom tray was not installed properly (it should slide and snap in place) and ended up on the heating element, causing it to melt. Not happy with the experience, I had to replace the left wheel from a third-party source due to the negligence of the incompetent installation crew. In the end, Home Depot lost out on more appliance purchases due to the negligence of the installation crew.

Sentence (English): For over 3 years, we had no problems with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Sadly this purchase has turned me off LG for life ] || ---------------- || For over 3 years, we had no problems with this dishwasher. Looked after it impeccably, cleaning it as instructed by the manufacturer. Then, out of the blue we started getting the "HE" error and basically the dishwasher would not complete any cycle, except for the "turbo" cycle, which is an absolutely useless clean. Anything that involved heat results in an error mid-way through the cycle. Now, the ridiculous question is, do we spend $500 fixing the thing, with no assurance that it will not break down again? My advice when appliance shopping - don't pay attention to reviews where someone has owned the product for 5 minutes. What you want to look at is the product's longevity and what problems start popping up over time. This was not a cheap dishwasher and should not have started breaking down after such a short period. Such a regrettable purchase, probably destined for landfill. So upsetting as it was great until it wasn't anymore.

Sentence (English): This is a great basic dishwasher that cleans and drys well while being relatively quiet - unfortunately it omits a few basic settings that previously were standard even on basic models such as selectable heated dry (see below) and a rinse only mode to give dirty dishes a quick rinse when you aren't ready to run a full load.
Comments (English): [ Great basic dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || This is a great basic dishwasher that cleans and drys well while being relatively quiet - unfortunately it omits a few basic settings that previously were standard even on basic models such as selectable heated dry (see below) and a rinse only mode to give dirty dishes a quick rinse when you aren't ready to run a full load. First I want to dispel some misinformation on prior reviews. This does have heated dry on both the Normal and Heavy cycles, unfortunately it is not selectable so it is always heated dry on both cycles. To avoid the heated dry you must use the 1 hour cycle. Dry works great on ours as long as we have rinse aid in the dispenser, drying performance is severely impacted when the dispenser goes dry. One other personal recommend is to clean the filter regularly, it is a very fine filter and it gets caked up quickly which will cause smells between use and poor washing performance. Fortunately GE made it a cinch to remove the filter and rinse it out, takes maybe 1-2 minutes max so I give it a good rinse every week. If you untwist the "basket" inside the fine filter it makes it easier to get the inside of the fine mesh filter clean.Bonus note. While this dishwasher is not meant to have the 3rd rack which is standard/available on higher end models it has the mounting points to install the one you can buy from GE which I did. It allowed me to store the utensil basket and open up room on the lower rack and use the 3rd rack for utensils, it does eat into the 2nd rack space but the rack easily slides out if you need the extra height on 2nd rack. Cheap and easy upgrade to this basic dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ Decent Microwave but Loud (And now Door Droops) ] || ---------------- || We have had this microwave for 4 years. It's been a pretty decent unit as far as performance but I don't think I'd buy it again. It's pretty loud when operating-the fan, I guess. The beep when a timer or cooking ends is really loud which is good and bad. It repeats every few moments without end. (At least I've never found a way to turn it off other than opening the door.) So if you want to cook something and leave it (for instance a baked potato), the beeping will drive you crazy. You need to be prepared to open the door or press a button when microwave finishes.Now, the door is drooping just the tiniest bit. But it's impacting the sensor, so we have hold the door up a fraction to get it to start. But I'm learning that's a common issue with many microwaves. Our last microwave lasted for more than 15 years, probably closer to 20. I wish appliances today had a longer lifetime.

Sentence (English): This is a great basic dishwasher that cleans and drys well while being relatively quiet - unfortunately it omits a few basic settings that previously were standard even on basic models such as selectable heated dry (see below) and a rinse only mode to give dirty dishes a quick rinse when you aren't ready to run a full load.
Comments (English): [ Great basic dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || This is a great basic dishwasher that cleans and drys well while being relatively quiet - unfortunately it omits a few basic settings that previously were standard even on basic models such as selectable heated dry (see below) and a rinse only mode to give dirty dishes a quick rinse when you aren't ready to run a full load. First I want to dispel some misinformation on prior reviews. This does have heated dry on both the Normal and Heavy cycles, unfortunately it is not selectable so it is always heated dry on both cycles. To avoid the heated dry you must use the 1 hour cycle. Dry works great on ours as long as we have rinse aid in the dispenser, drying performance is severely impacted when the dispenser goes dry. One other personal recommend is to clean the filter regularly, it is a very fine filter and it gets caked up quickly which will cause smells between use and poor washing performance. Fortunately GE made it a cinch to remove the filter and rinse it out, takes maybe 1-2 minutes max so I give it a good rinse every week. If you untwist the "basket" inside the fine filter it makes it easier to get the inside of the fine mesh filter clean. Bonus note. While this dishwasher is not meant to have the 3rd rack which is standard/available on higher end models it has the mounting points to install the one you can buy from GE which I did. It allowed me to store the utensil basket and open up room on the lower rack and use the 3rd rack for utensils, it does eat into the 2nd rack space but the rack easily slides out if you need the extra height on 2nd rack. Cheap and easy upgrade to this basic dishwasher.

Sentence (English): The Bosch Serie 8 SMD8TCX01E dishwasher offers excellent cleaning performance and smart features that make it an excellent choice for the home.
Comments (English): [ Excellent performance, app needs improvement ] || ---------------- || The Bosch Serie 8 SMD8TCX01E dishwasher offers excellent cleaning performance and smart features that make it an excellent choice for the home. However, the app has some shortcomings that could be inconvenient for family use. I was very happy with the cleaning performance of this dishwasher. The dishes always come out perfectly clean and dry, even in Eco mode. In addition, the start time pre-select and the ability to remotely control the dishwasher via the app are very convenient. However, the app has some shortcomings that I think are important for optimal family use. First, the feature for sharing the app with other family members is cumbersome and requires sharing your own login details, as the "invite another person" feature does not seem to work properly. Second, the notifications at the end of the wash cycle do not indicate which type of cycle has been completed, which can cause confusion. Despite these criticisms, I think the Bosch Serie 8 SMD8TCX01E dishwasher is an excellent product, especially for those looking for high cleaning performance and smart features. However, I recommend that Bosch improve the app to make it more user-friendly and tailored to the needs of families.
Comments (Original): [ Top Leistung, App verbesserungsbedürftig ] || ---------------- || Der Bosch Serie 8 SMD8TCX01E Geschirrspüler bietet eine hervorragende Reinigungsleistung und intelligente Funktionen, die ihn zu einer ausgezeichneten Wahl für zu Hause machen. Die App weist jedoch einige Mängel auf, die bei der Nutzung in der Familie unangenehm sein könnten.Ich war sehr zufrieden mit der Reinigungsleistung dieses Geschirrspülers. Das Geschirr kommt immer perfekt sauber und trocken heraus, sogar im Eco-Modus. Außerdem sind die Startzeitvorwahl und die Möglichkeit, den Geschirrspüler per App fernzusteuern, sehr praktisch.Die App weist jedoch einige Mängel auf, die meiner Meinung nach für eine optimale Nutzung in der Familie wichtig sind. Erstens ist die Funktion zum Teilen der App mit anderen Familienmitgliedern umständlich und erfordert die Weitergabe der eigenen Zugangsdaten, da die Funktion 'Eine andere Person einladen' nicht richtig zu funktionieren scheint. Zweitens geben die Benachrichtigungen am Ende des Spülvorgangs nicht an, welche Art von Zyklus abgeschlossen wurde, was zu Verwirrung führen kann.Trotz dieser Kritikpunkte halte ich den Bosch Serie 8 SMD8TCX01E Geschirrspüler für ein hervorragendes Produkt, insbesondere für diejenigen, die eine hohe Reinigungsleistung und intelligente Funktionen suchen. Ich empfehle Bosch jedoch, die App zu verbessern, um sie benutzerfreundlicher und an die Bedürfnisse von Familien anzupassen.

I can not believe I waited so long to get a dishwasher- now I get that time back with my family. So yes, do it- you won't regret it!!!

Sentence (English): My expectations were not met.
Comments (English): My expectations were not met. After hearing so many raves from friends and family about their Bosch dishwashers we couldn't wait to get ours. We opted for the 500 series in favor of its superior drying capability and stainless inside. After running 3 cycles I called the number provided for issues within 48 hours of delivery thinking something must be wrong with the drying cycle; despite filling the machine with rinse aid and setting the dryness preference to high, my plastic dishes all seemed pretty wet (our previous washer was a basic level GE profile and it did a superior job at drying). The customer service was great and essentially set me up to get a replacement dishwasher after I told them what was happening. HOWEVER, the replacement dishwasher is doing the same exact thing which leads me to believe this dishwasher is just not a good model. Additionally, I have not been able to figure out how to manage the settings without utilizing the home connect app. Our WiFi is not great at our house so it took over an hour for me to connect the dishwasher to the app. This is frustrating because as I am the only one with the ability to connect I am the only one who can control the dishwasher settings and thus the only one to run the dishwasher. I wonder what someone does who is not tech savvy or doesn't have a WiFi connection. I am considering requesting a different product.

Sentence (English): This is a great dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ TLDR; this is a great dishwasher. Get it now. ] || ---------------- || This is a great dishwasher. It replaced a very old, stinky Hotpoint dishwasher that came with our house. Point of note: I had to buy a \"rounded\" 90 degree brass elbow, because the one with a sharp 90 degree turn would not fit through the custom attachment that is included with this Samsung dishwasher. That said, the install was relatively simple:. - Connect water supply elbow. - Connect power to the front. I used a power cord that has strain relief, and it fit nicely into the power box at the front of the dishwasher. - Make adjustments as needed for power. Clearance is minimal at the bottom, so if you have a junction box sitting on the floor, you may need to mount it properly in the wall, which is safer anyway. - Connect drain line to your garbage disposal or sink drain. Best to route it \"high\" to prevent backflow into the dishwasher from the sink or garbage disposal. Additionally, though my space is indeed sized for a 36\" dishwasher, I don't think they accounted for the size of insulation batting. It was a bit of a bear to push on the insulation so I could very carefully fit the dishwasher into its cabinet space. Once I had that done, I leveled it off, trimmed the mounting brackets, and secured it to the bottom of the counter. Now, the part you came for: functionality. The touch sensitive controls are very nice. When we ran this for the first time, I almost couldn't believe it was running properly. It is remarkably quiet, so much so that I can forget that it's even running, even when working around my kitchen. If the TV is on, it's not a bother _at all_. The loudest thing is the sink draining during the cycle - not even the dishwasher, at all. As for cleaning ability, when paired with a rinse aid, this dishwasher is leagues better than my old one. It simply does a great job. It's got three spray arms - one for the third rack at the very top, one for the middle, and one for the bottom. The shelf spacing is extremely generous, meaning I can fit tall pans in there without issue. Additionally, the tines are spaced and angled such that, at least with my dishes, everything stands up straight on the bottom. The result is that I can put more dishes in there than I ever could with my old dishwasher. I also really like the cutlery bin. It's sized so I can just place my cutlery in without any hassle, and it keeps things spaced so that they get cleaned properly.

Clearance is minimal at the bottom, so if you have a junction box sitting on the floor, you may need to mount it properly in the wall, which is safer anyway.- Connect drain line to your garbage disposal or sink drain. Best to route it \'high\' to prevent backflow into the dishwasher from the sink or garbage disposal.Additionally, though my space is indeed sized for a 36\' dishwasher, I don't think they accounted for the size of insulation batting. It was a bit of a bear to push on the insulation so I could very carefully fit the dishwasher into its cabinet space. When we ran this for the first time, I almost couldn't believe it was running properly. It is remarkably quiet, so much so that I can forget that it's even running, even when working around my kitchen. If the TV is on, it's not a bother _at all_. The loudest thing is the sink draining during the cycle - not even the dishwasher, at all.As for cleaning ability, when paired with a rinse aid, this dishwasher is leagues better than my old one. It simply does a great job. It's got three spray arms - one for the third rack at the very top, one for the middle, and one for the bottom. The shelf spacing is extremely generous, meaning I can fit tall pans in there without issue. Additionally, the tines are spaced and angled such that, at least with my dishes, everything stands up straight on the bottom. The result is that I can put more dishes in there than I ever could with my old dishwasher. I also really like the cutlery bin. It's sized so I can just place my cutlery in without any hassle, and it keeps things spaced so that they get cleaned properly.

Sentence (English): We had to replace our dishwasher quickly when our beloved Bosch died and could not be repaired.
Comments (English): [ I would NOT recommend this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We had to replace our dishwasher quickly when our beloved Bosch died and could not be repaired. I looked at some reviews and it seemed like this Samsung would do the job, but I am not happy at all with this dishwasher and would not recommend it to anyone. The racks (all 3 levels) are very cheap and continuously fall off the rack, even with dishes in them. The dish dividers are very awkward so I can only fit about 60% of what I used to in my old dishwasher, meaning we're running it almost twice as often. The 3rd rack is not well set up and doesn't fit utensils very well, and the upper rack definitely does not hold glasses upright. One side is too narrow to fit glasses (I have a few different kinds and none of them fit properly) and the other side it too wide so the glasses fall over. Lastly and most importantly, the dishwasher does not clean the dishes thoroughly, even on the heavy setting. I always have a stack of dishes and utensils that I have to hand wash after they come out dirty. I have tried putting them in with food on them so the detergent and water have something to stick to, and I have tried putting them in well-rinsed, and there are always dirty dishes once the cycle is over. I use Finish rinse agent and either Cascade or Finish dishwasher pods, so it's not the quality of detergent I'm using. I talked to the Brick after a few loads (less than a week after getting the dishwasher) and was told their satisfaction guarantee does not apply to opened appliances, so I guess I will continue to be VERY unsatisfied with this dishwasher. Based on the poor quality so far, it will likely break in the next year or two so I can replace it then!

It replaced a very old, stinky Hotpoint dishwasher that came with our house.Point of note: I had to buy a "rounded" 90 degree brass elbow, because the one with a sharp 90 degree turn would not fit through the custom attachment that is included with this Samsung dishwasher. Additionally, the tines are spaced and angled such that, at least with my dishes, everything stands up straight on the bottom. The result is that I can put more dishes in there than I ever could with my old dishwasher. I also really like the cutlery bin. It's sized so I can just place my cutlery in without any hassle, and it keeps things spaced so that they get cleaned properly.

Sentence (English): Finally leaving a review for my Bosch 100 series from Lowes, installed correctly with high loop.

Best solution has been two successive Express Washes for each load, the first with dishwasher detergent and the second with a cup of vinegar added after the pumpout at the beginning of the cycle. Sentence (English): After many years and many many loads of dishes my original Bosch decided to retire, permanently!
Comments (English): [ Bosch dishwasher ] || ---------------- || After many years and many many loads of dishes my original Bosch decided to retire, permanently! There was never any question about what brand I would replace it with. Our new Bosch arrived several days later and was quickly installed. I love the replacement, it's quiet, the dishes are so clean, glasses sparkling. I am also very glad to have that upper shelf for knives and utensils. I did drop the middle shelf to accommodate for wine glasses , works perfectly! I do wish that it had a second or larger silverware basket. The one sometimes seems a bit too full, but I have learned to adapt by using the upper slide out shelf. My only other complaint is that the dishes are not entirely dry after the cycle is finished, but with that being said the glassware is clean and without water spots. It may be just a matter of me learning the machine and all of its features! Next time we're in the market for a new dishwasher ( hopefully not for a very long time) it will be a Bosch!

Sentence (English): I was a little sad to realize I needed a new dishwasher after having my previous one for only eight years.
Comments (English): [ It's quiet and fits a LOT ] || ---------------- || I was a little sad to realize I needed a new dishwasher after having my previous one for only eight years. This time I decided that I wanted some thing that I thought would last for an extended period of time so I decided I needed to spend a little bit more and get some thing of quality. Fast-forward after doing a lot of research online, I came to decide that this Bosch was what I wanted. I love the third row and the way that the drawer is set up so that it can hold every single piece of silverware that I own. The middle drawer can be lowered on either side, or only one side and work on the diagonal so everything fits! The bottom drawer has an additional silverware style basket, which I use for straws, but it can easily be removed if I have more plates. I mention that the heating element is not in the bottom so it's OK to put top rack only on the bottom shelf? It's life-changing! I am telling you this is by far the most versatile and best dishwasher I have ever owned. I am told that I can expect it to last a minimum of 10 years and possibly quite a bit longer. I am a convert and I believe should I ever need to purchase another dishwasher, I will not hesitate to only purchase a Bosch.

Sentence (English): I ordered it because I thought I wouldn't have time to wash dishes when I have a child.
Comments (English): [ God of Food, Making Life Easier ] || ---------------- || I ordered it because I thought I wouldn't have time to wash dishes when I have a child. Since it's a lease, I couldn't buy a big one, so I bought a small one. I was lucky that there was just enough space! Pros - The dishwashing time (labor time) is reduced. - It washes at high temperature, so it seems to disinfect better than I do. - Since it's hot water, it quickly fluffs up and becomes fluffy. - The door opens automatically, so you don't have to worry about it. - It's easy to use because the functions are simple. - It's neat and pretty. - The delivery person is also kind and nice. Cons - It's noisy. It's better to make a reservation and leave it on when you leave. It takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes to operate once. **Note** I don't know if dishwashers are like this. I don't think mine is the only one like this. - It's bigger than I thought. - But it doesn't seem to hold as much as I thought? It doesn't seem to be for 6 people. Maybe it's because I'm not good at Tetris yet. - Wash oily products once and put them in! It doesn't clean everything. Even with the strong setting, it doesn't clean as well as I did when I cleaned it diligently. Repurchase intention - I plan to buy a bigger one next time when I buy my own house! Overall review - There are many pros and cons, but I definitely recommend it because it saves me time at work. Please refer to the attached photos for the size and water connection :)

I'll give you a lifetime salary of 400,000 won and get rid of the dishwashing hell. ] || ---------------- || **Hello, this is a review of the Samsung dishwasher white product that I bought with my own money.** -*-Reason for purchase-*- I am a 3-person household with a baby, and to be honest, when it was a 2-person household, washing dishes wasn't that hard. However, after the baby was born, the number of baby bottles increased, and washing dishes while looking after the baby became very stressful. In particular, I enjoy grilling meat and cooking at home, but I was stressed out because there was so much oil, and I wondered how many times I had to wash the oil. My husband also said, "I can finish eating, but I'm busy taking care of the baby, washing dishes, and taking care of my mom!" So I thought a lot about buying a dishwasher, and I'm satisfied. -*-Product characteristics-*- It's for 6 people, but it seems suitable for a family of 2-3. They say that a 12-person one is good, but that means I have to collect dishes and do them, so there's a downside. This is really easy because you just put the dishes you want to eat and wash in it and press a button. Since it's a rental house, I asked the landlord if I could drill holes and installed it. I ordered other products because they said they could guide the holes, but Samsung said they couldn't, so I returned it and asked the landlord again and ordered it! I was able to choose the date I wanted, and the installer was very kind -*- Good points about this product compared to other products -*- The day this came in was the housewarming party, so I grilled pork belly, fried it, made japchae, and had a lot of dishes to wash, but my stress was reduced by more than half. In an instant, there were so many dishes and they were so oily that I should have washed my hands so much when I wash the dishes (I don't apply hand cream well because it's sticky, so my hands often chap). I just put it in, reserved it, and when I woke up, the lid was fully open, ventilation was good, and it was shiny! There are 5 courses, including standard, strong, and sterilization, and steam? So it goes crazy -*- Would you buy it again? -*- Would you recommend it? -*- Would you recommend it to people who read reviews? -*- I recommend it -*- Why do you recommend it? -*- Washing the dishes is really okay, but washing the dishes while watching the baby is another task. The downside is that it is a bit noisy, so the water goes in and out, etc. You can't do it very late at night, so you can make a reservation and set it for 1 hour, 2 hours, or 7 hours and it starts then! It's really the best. Personally, I have a dryer, food waste disposer, and oven, but when I bring in the dishwasher, I feel like the housework in my house is finished. **This is my honest review so far. If you find my review helpful, please click the "helpful" button. Thank you~ **.

It's really the best. Personally, I have a dryer, food waste disposer, and oven, but when I bring in the dishwasher, I feel like the housework in my house is finished. **This is my honest review so far. However, recently while cooking at home, I realized that this is dishwashing hell. I immediately thought I had to buy a dishwasher. Of course, I had to get a 12-person one, but not only was there the problem of installation, but I also had to bend my back every day. Since I have a back problem, they said it's better not to use coated pots and frying pans anyway, so I thought this capacity would be okay. I was worried because the design of the Objet Collection was prettier, but it dries with hot air, but it doesn't dry completely. There's no door-opening function after washing, so I passed. I was so satisfied with the dish dryer that I was going to buy the latest model with hot air drying, but the employee said that this also didn't dry completely, so I passed. Then there is only one conclusion: Samsung Bespoke Desktop 6-person! Natural marble non-perforated installation I thought the Samsung installation team would charge an additional fee for natural marble perforation, but that wasn't the case. You have to pre-perforate it for installation. But isn't the perforation cost over 100,000 won for a 400,000 won dishwasher? (But I would have drilled it if I lived in this house for more than 3 years.) So I racked my brain and thought about how to install it without perforating the marble and installed it like in the picture. It didn't cost any money because it was perforated on the sink door, and the white line is a bit annoying, but it's not bad :) Product performance and satisfaction The noise starts at the beginning and gets a little loud for a while, but it's not bad enough to need to run away, and you can watch TV. After washing, there's quite a bit of moisture after it opens automatically, but if you leave it as it is, it dries automatically. As the moisture dries, the wine glass gets a little stained, as in the picture. I use a 27cm large plate, and it's okay because it lies flat when I put it in, but it's a little inconvenient to put it in and take it out. I put the dish in, and there was space above, so I put a cutting board or frying pan on it and turned it, but the washing wing at the top was covered, so the dish couldn't be washed cleanly. When I put in tall dishes like pots, Make sure the upper washing blade does not touch the bowl. I cut the Ecover unscented in half and used it, but when I turned it with a plate or frying pan that smelled like fish, the bowl had a fishy smell, so I used the mandarin scent and this part was cleanly resolved. As a result of using it for about a month, the coated pot became unstable when I turned it, so I had to wash it by hand.
