Sentence (English): I live alone and have been debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher for a long time.
Comments (English): [ Samsung dishwasher with great value for money! ] || ---------------- || I live alone and have been debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher for a long time. I have watched many videos on YouTube about dishwashers. I really thought about it, but in the end, I was not in a hurry so I put it aside for a while. But every time I wash the dishes, the word 'leverage' kept coming to mind so I decided to buy it. I guess everyone has a lot of concerns before buying, right? I did the same. Price - 390,000 won At first, I was thinking about a 3-person Minix product, but the price was similar to a 6-person dishwasher, so I was worried a lot, and a 3-person dishwasher in the 200,000 won range was relatively cheap, so I wondered if the dishes would be washed well. In the end, I chose the Samsung 6-person because of its name value and the price of a 6-person dishwasher under 400,000 won. Function - Will it wash well? Yes, it does. It even opens the door automatically~ There was a big price difference between the 3-person and 6-person models, so I looked into the difference and it was the direction of the water flow. There are products that pour water from all sides, products that pour water from the top and bottom, and products that pour water only from the bottom. This product pours water from the top and bottom. Therefore, the cleaning power is also excellent. I was worried about the cleaning power because it is relatively cheap for 6 people, but the conclusion is that the cleaning power is not a problem! It is also equipped with an automatic door opening function, so you don't have to worry about water dripping even if you run the dishwasher and go out. Design - Simple modern white BESPOKE The white bespoke design that looks stylish and doesn't look out of place no matter where you put it brightens up the dull kitchen. Bolmae Bolmae! Brand - Samsung I watched several YouTube videos, but most of the small dishwasher manufacturers are Chinese media products. Cuckoo, SK Magic, Samsung, etc. They are all the same manufacturers. This product is the same, but since it has the Samsung brand, it's leveled up, so I forget the manufacturer. --------------- When I wash dishes for a long time, I do it for 20~30 minutes, but sometimes I get dizzy. I think 'leverage, leverage' in my head, but I hesitated because my finances are light. I rationalized that it was worth it if it was under 400,000 won. If I had a dishwasher, I could read one more page of a book, exercise a little more, and save more water and gas! Rationalize it ------------ Cons I received it on December 19th and have used it for over a month, but I swear I couldn't find any cons. It's the product I'm most satisfied with among all the products I've bought. If my review helped you choose a product, please click [Helpful].

Sentence (English): It arrived and installed in two days.
Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Sentence (English): When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse.
Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Sentence (English): Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent.
Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Sentence (English): Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher?
Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. Sentence (English): I got angry and called another repairman.
Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Comments (English): [ The installers are always friendly ] || ---------------- || It arrived and installed in two days. I don't usually write reviews, but I have to write one this time. This is also the reason why I took off one star. I installed the same model Samsung dishwasher in October 2023 and used it well for about 3 months. However, since the end of December, detergent powder has been on the dishes and inside the dishwasher (I attached a picture below). I am requesting after-sales service. The technician came and looked and said it was detergent powder. He told me to reduce the amount of detergent. (In the picture, he used half of the original amount.) When I said I would use less, he told me to use rinse. I was using rinse originally. He told me to change the detergent. Not solid detergent, but liquid detergent. It's the same even if I change it. The same thing happened with the SK3 detergent I used before the solid detergent. Then, isn't there a problem with the dishwasher? The dishwasher works well and there is no problem. Even if I change the detergent and run it on strong, he told me to call him. I called the technician and sent him a photo saying it was the same, and he told me to send him a video of the white substance inside the dishwasher and get the water quality checked. I don't understand. If that's the case from the beginning, I would have thought it was a problem with the minerals or tap water, but it was so clean before. When I asked the apartment, they said that the water quality of the apartment has not been checked or replaced since September. However, the technician said that the phenomenon occurs due to the temperature difference between the tap water and the detergent, so if it really bothers me, I should use a water purifier filter at the inlet where the tap water comes out. When I asked him if he was crazy and why he was using the dishwasher, he insisted that it wasn't a defect in the dishwasher and made the customer learn about water quality. I got angry and called another repairman. The technician said the same thing. In conclusion, I told him to take the dishwasher because I couldn't use it. I told the customer center what the second technician did to the previous technician, and he said that he would look into a refund without saying a word, but I left open the possibility that it might not work. I told the company that I would ask for a refund on the way, and if it worked, they would. The next day, they called and asked me to send them a photo receipt. I attached 5 photos and sent them a photo of the receipt, and they said they would refund me, so I got a refund. The reasons I bought the same model again are 1. The price range is reasonable. 2. It was convenient to use because it was in front of the cutlery holder. 3. I was used to using it, so I didn't want to change it to another one. 4. I bought the same model again just to use it. 5. According to reviews of dishwashers, Samsung is the best. (I replaced the SK3-person one because it was too small before.) I hope that this time, there won't be such a problem.

Sentence (English): Among my aunts, there was only one dishwasher, but I finally bought it after much deliberation!
Comments (English): [ I finally got to know Aunt Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Among my aunts, there was only one dishwasher, but I finally bought it after much deliberation! I was debating between a 12-person one and a 6-person one because the house structure was ambiguous about installing it under the induction stove. First of all, I am very satisfied. I didn't buy it because I have a personality that just needs to wash the dishes quickly, but it feels like I didn't wash the dishes enough? I put it in after eating and putting it in, and it's so convenient. It was my first time, so I only used detergent, but I bought rinse because I heard that it wouldn't stain if I used it with conditioner. It ran for about 1:10 minutes, and the noise wasn't loud enough to be bothersome, and the door opened automatically when it was done. If I leave it on at night and sleep, it will probably be dry in the morning. There were quite a few reviews of unfriendly technicians, but I had two friendly technicians come and install it happily ((Review after using it for about a week)) Now I know why they call it a dishwasher, aunt. Why did I buy it now? It's soooooo convenient. As I wrote above, I have a personality that really cleans up quickly, so I thought a dishwasher wouldn't suit me, but I was wrong. It's so convenient. Since I use the rinse together, there are no stains at all, and if I use it on high speed, it runs for about 57 minutes and the door opens automatically when 2 minutes are left, so I love that it's all dry in the morning when I run it at night and go to sleep. When there's not much to wash, I cut the detergent in half and use it. It's for 6 people, but if you're good at Tetris, it holds a lot! I don't think you'll regret buying it if you're hesitant^^ ((One-month review)) Don't ask, it's a no-questions-asked purchase! Since it was the last time I bought a dishwasher, I thought I'd be fast even without a dishwasher, but no, dishwasher aunt wins! It's really, really convenient. My child was sick during this holiday, so I stayed home for 4 days, and since I was eating three meals a day, there were really lots of dishes to wash, but the dishwasher worked hard. After eating, I just rinsed the scum off with water and put it in, so it doesn't even take 5 minutes. My child, who always waited for the dishes to be finished, really likes it when mom quickly cleans up and plays with them. Was it a little noisy in the beginning? I thought about it, but if I put it away and do something else, there are times when I can't hear it well because of the ambient noise. For those of you who are hesitating, don't worry and buy it, I hope you feel the convenience!

Comments (English): [ I finally got to know Aunt Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Among my aunts, there was only one dishwasher, but I finally bought it after much deliberation! I was debating between a 12-person one and a 6-person one because the house structure was ambiguous about installing it under the induction stove. First of all, I am very satisfied. I didn't buy it because I have a personality that just needs to wash the dishes quickly, but it feels like I didn't wash the dishes enough? I put it in after eating and putting it in, and it's so convenient. It was my first time, so I only used detergent, but I bought rinse because I heard that it wouldn't stain if I used it with conditioner. It ran for about 1:10 minutes, and the noise wasn't loud enough to be bothersome, and the door opened automatically when it was done. If I leave it on at night and sleep, it will probably be dry in the morning. There were quite a few reviews of unfriendly technicians, but I had two friendly technicians come and install it happily ((Review after using it for about a week)) Now I know why they call it a dishwasher, aunt. Why did I buy it now? It's soooooo convenient. As I wrote above, I have a personality that really cleans up quickly, so I thought a dishwasher wouldn't suit me, but I was wrong. It's so convenient. Since I use the rinse together, there are no stains at all, and if I use it on high speed, it runs for about 57 minutes and the door opens automatically when 2 minutes are left, so I love that it's all dry in the morning when I run it at night and go to sleep. When there's not much to wash, I cut the detergent in half and use it. It's for 6 people, but if you're good at Tetris, it holds a lot! I don't think you'll regret buying it if you're hesitant^^ ((One-month review)) Don't ask, it's a no-questions-asked purchase! Since it was the last time I bought a dishwasher, I thought I'd be fast even without a dishwasher, but no, dishwasher aunt wins! It's really, really convenient. My child was sick during this holiday, so I stayed home for 4 days, and since I was eating three meals a day, there were really lots of dishes to wash, but the dishwasher worked hard. After eating, I just rinsed the scum off with water and put it in, so it doesn't even take 5 minutes. My child, who always waited for the dishes to be finished, really likes it when mom quickly cleans up and plays with them. Was it a little noisy in the beginning? I thought about it, but if I put it away and do something else, there are times when I can't hear it well because of the ambient noise. For those of you who are hesitating, don't worry and buy it, I hope you feel the convenience!

I put it in after eating and putting it in, and it's so convenient. It was my first time, so I only used detergent, but I bought rinse because I heard that it wouldn't stain if I used it with conditioner. My child, who always waited for the dishes to be finished, really likes it when mom quickly cleans up and plays with them. Was it a little noisy in the beginning? I thought about it, but if I put it away and do something else, there are times when I can't hear it well because of the ambient noise. For those of you who are hesitating, don't worry and buy it, I hope you feel the convenience!

Sentence (English): Why did I buy it now?
Comments (English): [ I finally got to know Aunt Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Among my aunts, there was only one dishwasher, but I finally bought it after much deliberation! I was debating between a 12-person one and a 6-person one because the house structure was ambiguous about installing it under the induction stove. First of all, I am very satisfied. I didn't buy it because I have a personality that just needs to wash the dishes quickly, but it feels like I didn't wash the dishes enough? I put it in after eating and putting it in, and it's so convenient. It was my first time, so I only used detergent, but I bought rinse because I heard that it wouldn't stain if I used it with conditioner. It ran for about 1:10 minutes, and the noise wasn't loud enough to be bothersome, and the door opened automatically when it was done. If I leave it on at night and sleep, it will probably be dry in the morning. There were quite a few reviews of unfriendly technicians, but I had two friendly technicians come and install it happily ((Review after using it for about a week)) Now I know why they call it a dishwasher, aunt. Why did I buy it now? It's soooooo convenient. As I wrote above, I have a personality that really cleans up quickly, so I thought a dishwasher wouldn't suit me, but I was wrong. It's so convenient. Since I use the rinse together, there are no stains at all, and if I use it on high speed, it runs for about 57 minutes and the door opens automatically when 2 minutes are left, so I love that it's all dry in the morning when I run it at night and go to sleep. When there's not much to wash, I cut the detergent in half and use it. It's for 6 people, but if you're good at Tetris, it holds a lot! I don't think you'll regret buying it if you're hesitant^^ ((One-month review)) Don't ask, it's a no-questions-asked purchase! Since it was the last time I bought a dishwasher, I thought I'd be fast even without a dishwasher, but no, dishwasher aunt wins! It's really, really convenient. My child was sick during this holiday, so I stayed home for 4 days, and since I was eating three meals a day, there were really lots of dishes to wash, but the dishwasher worked hard. After eating, I just rinsed the scum off with water and put it in, so it doesn't even take 5 minutes. My child, who always waited for the dishes to be finished, really likes it when mom quickly cleans up and plays with them. Was it a little noisy in the beginning? I thought about it, but if I put it away and do something else, there are times when I can't hear it well because of the ambient noise. For those of you who are hesitating, don't worry and buy it, I hope you feel the convenience!

I put it in after eating and putting it in, and it's so convenient. If I leave it on at night and sleep, it will probably be dry in the morning. My child, who always waited for the dishes to be finished, really likes it when mom quickly cleans up and plays with them. Was it a little noisy in the beginning? I thought about it, but if I put it away and do something else, there are times when I can't hear it well because of the ambient noise. For those of you who are hesitating, don't worry and buy it, I hope you feel the convenience!

Sentence (English): I ordered the dishwasher and it was delivered in two days.
Comments (English): [ It's the best ] || ---------------- || I ordered the dishwasher and it was delivered in two days. I thought it would be big, but it feels bigger than I thought. I think it's because I had to leave some space because of the work behind me. I used to use the SK Magic 6-person, but I didn't use the dishwasher when I moved, but I recently bought it because of my wrist pain. It seems lower and deeper than the SK Magic, and it's single-tier, so you can put a lot of pots in it! The location of the sink in my house is perfect, so I can put it in the dishwasher without dropping a single drop of water, which is great! I was thinking of buying a built-in type, but I didn't want to bend over, and since there aren't many dishes unless there are guests, I bought a 6-person one, and it's big enough. It's big enough to easily cover a meal for a family of four. I turned it on in standard mode, but it didn't dry completely without any moisture, and there were beads of water, but when I opened the door, took out the shelf, and left it for a while, it dried quickly, probably because of the heat. A few things I wish there was a transparent window on the tempered glass part on the front! I couldn't see the dishwashing process, so I'm curious. Another thing is the color of the drain pipe. How nice would it have been if the drain pipe had been white? The drain pipe and the water supply pipe are a bit unsightly, but I guess I have to put up with that. The water supply pipe needs to be drilled into the sink top, but I didn't want to drill it, so I put it in the gap between the top and the lower cabinet and finished it. It doesn't look good, but it's better than drilling it. I only used 1/4 of a solid detergent, but the dishes were washed cleanly. The dishes were oily, but they're sparkling and clean. I'm very satisfied. The design is very pretty, as expected from Bespoke, and the Samsung installers were very kind and installed it quickly. Worries only delay the delivery~

Comments (English): [ Best home appliances I bought this year ] || ---------------- || - Reason for purchase We have many aunts at home, such as a robot vacuum cleaner, food waste disposer, etc.! Even if two people eat, there aren't many dishes, so I didn't think it was necessary to buy a dishwasher, so I didn't buy it. Then, I heard that they wanted to try it out, so I looked into it and bought it. - Reason for purchase recommendation 1) There are many opinions that a 2-3 person dishwasher is actually suitable for a single-person household! In particular, for those who mainly eat Korean food, eat with many side dishes, or cook directly, and a 2-person household with a lot of dishes to wash, I highly recommend using a 6-person dishwasher! 2) I looked into cost-effective, non-contact 2-3 person dishwashers. When I was actually going to buy one, the price was similar to a 6-person one. So after looking through various reviews, I found this product to be cheaper than the 6-person one and it was on sale at Coupang, so I bought it right away. - Review 1) I bought the all-white one and I'm very satisfied! The price differs by 10,000-20,000 won depending on the color! I was going to buy the pink one because it was the cheapest, but I just bought the one I liked and I'm very satisfied! 2) Cleaning power You will see dishes that are cleaned much cleaner than you thought and dried cleanly without any water stains, so I think I made a good purchase. 3) Perforation This product is installed by a Samsung technician! But there is a condition! It is only if you perforate the sink or connect it in the regular way. I live in a rented house, so I couldn't perforate it, so I searched the Internet and connected the water supply pipe using the faucet near the sink. As a result, I only received support up to the delivery level. However, I am satisfied because I don't have to contact the landlord inconveniently due to the perforation. However, there is a minor inconvenience in that I have to supply water while the dishwasher is running because it doesn't automatically supply water. 4) Detergent cost *** Kirklan@ A new dishwasher detergent has come out, and I am using it because it seems to be cost-effective~ - Overall review Whether it is perforated or not, there is a way, so you should definitely buy it! You can spend more time at home by saving time from not washing dishes.

Sentence (English): I am appalled at the Miele customer service I have received after a delivery of a faulty dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Appalling customer service ] || ---------------- || I am appalled at the Miele customer service I have received after a delivery of a faulty dishwasher. A qualified plumber installed a dishwasher 4 weeks ago. The dishwasher is not functioning. I called Miele and they have sent an electrician who has advised that the pressure in the pipes is too high and I need to install a pressure reduction valve.
